coaching.title: Today's Run
coaching.message: Easy 6–7 miles, Z2 (140 bpm or lower), rolling terrain if possible. You're 38 days out and in taper week 20; the goal is to maintain aerobic tone without accumulating fatigue. Yesterday's 8-miler at 121 bpm was solid and within phase. Today dial it back—your resting HR is 62 (3.3 bpm below your 30-day average of 65.3), a strong sign of adaptation, so don't waste it by pushing. Skip hard intervals; save sharpness work for Friday if the week demands it.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: You're running on travel schedule and your sleep efficiency dipped to 62.4% (vs. 8.21h average). Prioritize carb-forward meals today: 5–7g carbs per kg bodyweight, spread across four meals. On an easy 6-miler, consume 30–45g carbs during the run (one gel or sports drink) if you're fueling for adaptation. Post-run: protein + carbs within 60 minutes. If you're eating in airports or hotels this week, pre-plan: rice bowls, pasta, fruit, and electrolyte drink mix. Sleep debt = elevated glycogen turnover.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Your 7h52m sleep with 62.4% efficiency is below your baseline; you're likely spending 2–3 hours in light or fragmented sleep. With work travel, enforce a hard bedtime 30 minutes earlier than yesterday and kill screen time 45 minutes before sleep. Hydration status affects sleep quality—drink 500mL water 2 hours before bed, not 30 minutes. The Julian Alps will demand sharp decision-making on rough terrain at altitude; sleep is non-negotiable in taper. This week's volume (11.1 miles so far) is intentionally light; use the deficit to recover sleep debt, not to add extra runs.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: You've built serious durability: 47 miles last week, consistent Z2 work, and your RHR drop shows adaptation is real. In taper, resist the urge to 'make up' for lighter volume—that's where athletes implode. Your recovery score is 75/100 (solid green), and that's the result of respecting the plan. Spend mental energy this week on pre-race logistics: visa confirmation, race kit shakedown, altitude arrival timeline for Slovenia (you'll want 3–5 days to acclimatize at Kranjska Gora before Sept 18). The 50K's sparse aid and 2,500m vert will punish under-prepared runners; your training is done.
